items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: And there was Walter Birch, he used to play with the Hill City too over there, the tambour, the tambour.

ctx.x: Hill City, say. Yeah, that's old. I went to bed around about three or four years old. And my brother used to play it. My oldest brother. And Walter Burke and that band and Charlie Vidal. You ever heard of Charlie Vidal? Now what did he play? He's a little fella like me. What did he play? He played chord it, clarinet, violin, bass, guitar, any kind of. All around me. Yeah, he was really a professor. And he could play too. And at first I thought he just could play his violin. So I went up there, I was playing…
And get the instruments. What instruments?
